map.PTSD检查表第5版(PCL-5)，针对过去一个月内对最严重创伤经历的反应自评。: PTSD Checklist for DSM-5 (PCL-5) is a self-report on reactions to the worst traumatic event in the past month. 20 items, 0-4 each, total 0-80. Cutoff 31-33 suggests possible PTSD.
map.PCL-5总分 = Σ20个条目（每项0-4，满分80）；按B重新体验、C回避、: PCL-5 total = sum of 20 items (0-4, max 80); clustered as B re-experiencing, C avoidance, D negative cognition, E hyperarousal; higher total means worse PTSD symptoms.
map.本量表为自助筛查工具，不能替代精神科专业诊断。PCL-5≥31建议进一步接受专业: This is a self-help screening tool and does not replace psychiatric diagnosis. PCL-5 >=31 suggests further professional trauma assessment.
map.20 项 0–4：B 侵入 5 项合计 9（≥1 项>0）、C 回避 2 项合计: 20 items 0-4: B intrusion 5 sum 9 (>=1 >0), C avoidance 2 sum 4 (>=1), D negative 7 sum 14 (>=2), E arousal 6 sum 11 (>=2) -> total 38, meets DSM clusters and >=31, likely PTSD.
map.合计 22 但某聚类条目数不足 → 不满足 DSM 标准，建议随访与心理教育。: Total 22 but some cluster short on items -> does not meet DSM criteria; follow-up and psychoeducation advised.
map.常用总分 ≥31 且 B/C/D/E 各满足最少条目数（B≥1、C≥1、D≥2、: Commonly total >=31 and B/C/D/E each meet minimum items (B>=1, C>=1, D>=2, E>=2) indicates DSM-5 positive screen.
map.PCL-5 对应 DSM-5 四大聚类，可用于筛查但不能单独确诊，需临床访谈确认: PCL-5 maps to the four DSM-5 clusters; useful for screening but not standalone diagnosis; clinical interview must confirm trauma exposure.
map.创伤后应激(PCL-5)筛查器。医疗专业工具，基于权威医学标准，仅供参考。: PTSD Checklist (PCL-5). A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
